Type: Weapon
Function: Bleeding, bloodthirst, armor piercing
Introduction: A powerful bewitching demon fed this blade with its own blood. Over time, it became exceedingly bloodthirsty. Its edge can cut through solid steel, wounds inflicted by it are difficult to heal, and it absorbs its prey's blood essence to strengthen its owner.
Remark: A blade that does not covet its owner's blood is no good blade.

Type: Orb
Function: Enhancement, defense
Introduction: An item of the Earth Monster class, condensed from the power of the earth. It can enhance strength and defense.
Remark: Heaviness comes at a price.

Type: Vessel
Function: Poison
Introduction: In ancient times, a genius from a witchcraft tribe in the southern mountains set out to create an odorless, colorless poison that killed without a trace. After years of research, he completed this incense burner, only to find its poison weak and slow to act, so he discarded it. Half a month later, everyone in the tribe was dead.
Remark: Did you build up your poison resistance first?

Type: Fuel
Function: Suppress evil, purification
Introduction: An item left behind by the Lady of Mount Sandao, said to be refined from the fat of a long-burning beast. It can suppress evil and purify.
Remark: Purifying fear is not always a good thing. It also cannot be moved.
SPIRITUAL_REALM_WALKER_CARD_RED_DANCE_SH:
Type: Footwear
Function: Tracking, pursuit
Introduction: They once belonged to a princess of a western kingdom. Beautiful and gifted at dance, she drew the admiration of the kingdom's men. Her jealous stepmother imprisoned her in a high tower, where the lonely princess danced beneath the cold moonlight until she died. The shoes inherited her final wish and began to wander, dancing forever.
Remark I: Form I: Throw the shoes at a chosen target, or lock on through blood, hair, or other cells. They pursue the target without end, ignoring all physical barriers, until the target dies or finishes a dance with them. Any dance will do.
Form II: Wear the shoes to gain agility, improve evasion, and run across any terrain without spending stamina. They may be worn for only five minutes; beyond that they can never be removed, and you will run until death or until your feet are severed.
Remark II: Won't dance with me? Then die.

Type: Weapon
Function: Purification, spirit suppression, demon breaking
Introduction: A weapon containing the power of the sun god and the bane of all creatures of yin. Offer blood essence to the pestle to receive the sun god's power.
Remark: Powerful? It is bought with your life.
